notes.title: [AshBall DevLog #1 There is a Spirit in the Menu – UI Update & Minor Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]🔧 A Small Touch: The Menu Feels More Alive! 🔥[/h2]

[i]Hello there![/i]



Lately, I've been working on Blender, UI animation, and post-processing in Unity.

I've slowly started integrating what I learn into [b]AshBall[/b].



[b]In this update:[/b]

[list]
  [*]The menu title now has a [b]typewriter animation[/b] (with an actual [i]typewriter sound[/i] while typing 🖋️🎹)[/*]
  [*]The [b]Leaderboard button[/b] is now animated with a small "fire" effect that fits the lava theme[/*]
  [*]Some old UI elements were simplified for a [b]cleaner and more balanced look[/b][/*]
  [*][b]Post-processing adjustments[/b] were made for better tone harmony in the background[/*]
  [*]A rare [b]synchronization bug[/b] related to ball sharing was fixed[/*]
[/list]

[i]These may be small, but they add soul.[/i]

AshBall is still alive, learning, and growing 🍂🔥



[b]Thanks![/b]

notes.title: Update Incoming – It’s Gonna Be Intense!
notes.notes: [p][b]While testing the game, I found a way to hold the ball in my hands for way too long... [/b][/p][p][b]And let's say I fixed that up nicely. 😈 And trust me, it won't let you slip away from this bug.[/b][/p][p]This patch brings new pressure, more chaos, and a constantly rising tempo.[/p][p]We’re still working to make AshBall even more fun, intense, and unpredictable than what you saw in the trailer.[/p][p]Also — i currently looking for a passionate 2D artist to collaborate with me! [/p][p]If you love creating UI art or character designs and want to be part of something wild (and awesome), feel free to reach out: 8kyaoo@gmail.com[/p][p]Let’s make cool stuff together. ⚡[/p][p]If you're still up after this... I'm just getting started, yeeeeee!!![/p]
